items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of four conditions for a one dimensional integral Noetherian scheme: the existence of a regular alteration, the existence of a resolution of singularities, the existence of a finite sequence of blowups in closed points ending in a regular scheme, and finiteness of the normalization (statement lines 4247-4259). The proof (proof lines 4261-4304) disposes of the easy implications, factors a finite resolution through blowups of closed points while recording an ascending chain of coherent submodules, and concludes by the ascending chain condition. H3: an original termination argument via an ascending chain, written out in full.
